issues.detail: NO TAIL: no tail in this record holds an event or a checkpoint: there is no tails/ directory, so the record asserts no fact, and nothing verifies over nothing

clauses.text: external witness (T3): not covered, nothing outside this machine attests this record

result.summary: local integrity FAILED: see issues; 0 tail(s); no events yet; external witness (T3): not covered, nothing outside this machine attests this record

notAnswered: One tail removed whole while another remains is not a break: with its committed key left it IS reported, as a census note (informational, not a break, so the exit stays 0), and with its key removed too it may leave nothing to report. A record in which no tail holds anything is refused.
The newest events cut together with their checkpoint read as an honest record, under --require signed too.
A record erased and founded again reads as an honest record, under --require signed too.

One tail removed whole in a commit older than the revision --since compares with is not found by it. Only a copy of the record from before (--since <rev>, a git remote) shows any of these; the external witness dates a checkpoint and keeps no copy.
